sentences.en: Limestone underlies most of the site.
sentences.zh: 石灰岩覆盖了该地的大片区域。

sentences.en: The bristlecones grow well in limestone soil. Most trees do not grow well in such soil.
sentences.zh: 这些油松在石灰岩土壤中生长得很好，大多数树木在这种土壤中却难以存活。

sentences.en: The statue is made from a type of limestone.
sentences.zh: 这座雕像用石灰石制成。
